logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes (I-III) was detected by the classical “shake-flask” technique utilizing the standard procedure [29]. Each sample was dissolved in water (0.4 mM) and added to n-octanol solvent (10mL 1:1 v/v) and this mixture was shaken continuously overnight. Then, two phases (water and octanol) were separated according to literature methods [30]. UV-visible spectroscopy is utilized to obtain the concentration of palladium(II) complexes (I, II, and III) in each phase. The lipophilicity value of these complexes, partition coefficient (log P), was determined from Eq. (1): logP = log([Pd(II) complex]octanol phase / [Pd(II) complex]water phase)
